messages.en:
Walking around is fun and 
cheap. Heh, it doesn't get 
any cheaper than free!
{07 19 00}Yep,{01 00 00 05 00} it's pretty much right
up my alley, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Ringi kõndimine on lõbus ja 
odav. Heh, odavamaks kui 
tasuta ei lähe!
{07 19 00}Jah,{01 00 00 05 00} see sobib mulle
päris hästi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
I think randomly wandering 
around {04 03 00} is a
pretty sweet hobby.
Don't you think vagabonds
are cool, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 08 09}
Oh yeah!
Not really.
messages.et:
Ma arvan, et juhuslik 
uitamine {04 03 00}-s on
päris vinge hobi.
Kas sa ei arva, et hulkurid
on lahedad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 08 09}
Oh jaa!
Mitte eriti.

messages.en:
I don't stroll.{01 00 00 05 00} I don't
mosey.{01 00 00 05 00} I speed-walk,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Sounds kinda tough, right?
{01 00 00 0f 00}SPEED-WALKING!{01 01 00} 
{07 14 00}Serious stuff, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Ma ei jaluta.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei
tatsa.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma kiirkõnnin,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Kõlab päris karmilt, eks?
{01 00 00 0f 00}KIIRKÕND!{01 01 00} 
{07 14 00}Tõsine asi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}It's not like I think about
where to {04 22 00}
all the time!
{07 00 00}Sometimes, I like to walk
around to clear my head,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}You know, when I'm feeling
especially grumpy, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Pole nii, et ma mõtleks
kogu aeg, kus {04 22 00}
käia!
{07 00 00}Vahel meeldib mulle
kõndida ja mõtteid koguda,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}Tead, kui ma olen eriti
tusane, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
Do you wanna {07 0b 00}take a walk 
with me or somethin',
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}I probably won't ditch you
and run and hide,
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Kas sa tahad {07 0b 00}minuga 
jalutama minna või midagi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Ma ilmselt ei jäta sind
ja ei jookse peitu,
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}{01 08 00}LEG CRAMP!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Agggghhh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Why did I walk so
far? My legs are killin' me!
{07 00 00}The first thing I gotta do
is chug {04 13 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}{01 08 00}JALAKRAMP!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Agggghhh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Miks ma nii palju
kõndisin? Jalad tapavad!
{07 00 00}Esimene asi, mida pean
tegema: juua {04 13 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm NOT walking around
aimlessly, so quit lookin' at
me like that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I'm helping {04 0b 00} find
a lost {04 15 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma EI kõnni sihitult
ringi, nii et lõpeta minu
vahtimine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. {07 00 00}Ma
aitan tüüpi nimega {04 0b 00}
leida kaotatud {04 15 00}.

messages.en:

{01 00 00 14 00}follow me! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0d 00}We're gonna truck through
{04 03 00}, until we've

messages.et:

{01 00 00 14 00}järgne mulle! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0d 00}Me kammime läbi
{04 03 00}, kuni oleme
